_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

nov_floor_m.basis: the November award's stated floor in millions of dollars, over this amount, never exact

jan_award_m.basis: the January award toward the clean room, millions of dollars

room_total_m.basis: the clean room project total after Texas Tech's match, millions of dollars

tech_match_m.basis: the clean room total minus the January award, Texas Tech's match

may_award_m.basis: the May award, roughly this many millions of dollars, never exact

chips_act_year.basis: the year the Texas CHIPS Act was signed

awards_2026.basis: dated 2026 announcements of awards from the fund to this college in the record

usd_m_per_wafer.basis: DRAWING UNIT: one wafer stands for this many millions of dollars

jan_wafers.basis: wafers in the January boat at the drawing unit

match_wafers.basis: wafers in Texas Tech's matching boat at the drawing unit

may_whole.basis: whole wafers in the May boat at the drawing unit

may_part.basis: the remainder of roughly 4.5 at the drawing unit, drawn as a cleaved half wafer

nov_wafers.basis: wafers in the November boat at the drawing unit, the floor, with no far end plate

pitch_mm.basis: DRAWING CHOICE: boat slot pitch in millimetres

wafer_mm.basis: DRAWING CHOICE: wafer diameter in millimetres
